notes.title: Update 14.02.2019
notes.content:
[b]New in update:[/b]


Added waterfalls in level 1


[b]Bug fixes:[/b]


- Fixed water fountain particles for performance optimization

- Texture flickering in LVL 1 has been fixed

- Fixed most platforms so you don't have to double jump all the time in the tutorial level and level 1

notes.title: Update 05.02.2019
notes.content: Made changes to the checkpoint system and added a few extra checkpoints.

notes.title: Bug fixes 25.01.2019
notes.content:
- Made a change where notifications only show once but have a longer delay.

- Removed Dash and Sliding action from input settings, due to issues with events.
